title: How to edit Metakgp
text:
#REDIRECT Help:New editor's guide
One of the fundamental interactions with a Wiki involves adding and editing information to the existing collection. MetaKGP wiki uses MediaWiki software, a wiki platform used by Wikipedia and many other wiki sites. If you have ever edited a Wikipedia or similar page before, then MetaKGP is works exactly the same way. However, if this is your first time making an edit, we have some useful notes for you.

MetaKGP wiki uses two methods of editing: the new VisualEditor (VE), and classic editing through wiki markup (wikitext). Also, you do not need to register to do this.
